text: ポケモンずかんは　パソコンつうしんで　オーキドはかせに　みてもらえる！

structure.jp: オーキドはかせに　みてもらえる！
structure.en: you can have Professor Oak look at it!

patterns.name: 〜てもらう
patterns.span: オーキドはかせに　みてもらえる
patterns.explanation: てもらう says you get someone to do something for you, with に showing who does it; the える ending adds 'can'. オーキドはかせに みてもらえる = 'you can have Professor Oak look at it'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing shows the tool or way used to do something. パソコンつうしんで = 'by PC link'.
